profile.headline: Learning & Development Content Specialist at HPE | Technical Learning & Enablement | Learning Experience Design | Ed.D. Candidate
profile.summary:
Learning and Development professional with experience leading enterprise learning systems, technical training initiatives, and digital ecosystem strategy across complex organizations. Passionate about building scalable, accessible, and user-centered solutions that improve adoption, operational efficiency, and stakeholder engagement.
 
Brings a collaborative and systems-oriented approach to cross-functional work, combining technical fluency, instructional design, and process improvement to support evolving organizational and technology needs.

positions.title: Learning and Development Content Specialist
positions.locationName: Fort Collins, Colorado, United States · Remote
positions.description: Supporting learning and enablement for HPE Morpheus, with a focus on developing technical learning experiences and content that help users understand and successfully work with complex cloud technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer I - Learning Systems Integration Specialist
positions.locationName: Fort Collins, Colorado, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Manage the lifecycle of 200+ enterprise learning and SaaS platforms supporting 28,000+ users, including evaluation, onboarding, implementation, deployment readiness, and continuous improvement 
 • Design scalable technical training resources, onboarding systems, documentation, and knowledge base content 
 • Collaborate across IT, infrastructure, curriculum, procurement, legal, and vendor partners to support platform adoption and operational alignment 
 • Design workflow automation processes within ServiceNow to improve efficiency, transparency, and support scalability 
 • Lead accessibility and compliance enablement efforts aligned to WCAG 2.1 AA and Colorado digital accessibility legislation 
 • Conduct technology evaluation and impact analysis related to accessibility, governance, risk, and operational effectiveness 
 • Support user adoption through technical enablement, workflow-aligned guidance, and stakeholder communication
positions.insights: Skills: Relationship Building · Software Documentation · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) · Accessibility Audits · IT Accessibility · Interoperability · Data Privacy

positions.title: Adjunct Instructor, School of Education
positions.description:
- Adjunct Instructor for CTE Engineering, Information Technology, Business, and Marketing pre-service teachers - providing methods and materials for success in the classroom
- Adjunct Instructor for Educational Technology and Assessment course required by pre-service teachers to learn to build their toolkit for Technology and Assessment in the classroom.
- Supported the School of Education in aligning courses with Department initiatives and other instructors' courses.
- Mentored and taught pre-service teachers in Career & Technical Education, Engineering, Technology, and Assessment.

positions.title: Academic Success Coordinator & Instructor & Outreach Committee Chair & PhD Student
positions.locationName: Computer Science Dept, Fort Collins, CO
positions.description:
- Managed the Undergraduate Teaching Assistant program including recruitment, hiring, training, and assigning students to classes, empowering undergraduate students to take leadership positions within the department.
- Led the Outreach Committee, which included faculty, staff, and students, to build programs that would advocate for underrepresented populations in Computer Science, which ultimately increased the number of underrepresented populations in the major by 50%.
- Built relationships with key faculty and staff across campus to collaborate on curriculum, research, and summer camps.
- Responsible for marketing Computer Science department initiatives across campus and in the greater Colorado community.
- Advised 280+ undergraduate students in Computer Science and Applied Computer Technology Degrees, ensuring their success by tracking progress and communicating expectations.
- Taught 150+ students with prior programming knowledge the CS1 course content.
- Collaborated with admissions to recruit admitted high school students from across the state and nation to choose CS at CSU for post-secondary education.
- Collaborated with industry and K-12 teachers to advocate for computer science education and teacher credentialing across Colorado.
- Coordinated and organized summer camps for middle school through STEM-X Institutes to be held at CSU’s computer science building.
- Built curriculum for middle school summer camp to explore various concepts and fields in computer science.
- Worked on a team to further develop curriculum for CS1 class based on research and industry feedback.
- Organized CS-related professional development for teachers across northern Colorado for elementary, middle school, and high school.
- Submitted a Department of Education, Education Innovation and Research Grant to partner with 4H and rural communities across Colorado to integrate CS into their programs.
- Began research and PhD in Computer Science Education in Fall 2019.

positions.title: IT/Cyber Security Pathways Instructor & Department Chair
positions.description:
- Fully Credentialed by Front Range Community College, Colorado Community College System as well as the Colorado Department of Education to teach College Career and Technology Education credit to students including the courses: A+ Certification Preparation, Networking I, Network Security, Linux, Networking II, Firewalls and Advanced Network Security, Configuring Windows Server, and Incident Response.
- Cultivated cybersecurity curriculum to include penetration testing with various tools including Kali Linux, Wireshark, Burpsuite, nMap, Splunk using Virtual Machine technology, focusing on analysis and network configuration to mitigate risk.
- Engaged students in the Career and Technical Education Student Organization, Air & Space Forces Association's CyberPatriot, which provides a competition-based cybersecurity experience for students. Students participated in CyberQuest through Lockheed Martin in Colorado, and won 2nd place in 2023. 
- Created and built an Information Technology (IT)/Cyber Security Pathway for High School students to get industry recognized certifications, college credit through concurrent enrollment, and work-based learning.
- Proficient at a variety of Learning Management Systems including Canvas, Google Classroom, Schoology, and building websites to deliver content to a variety of student audiences from Middle School to University and Adult Education.
- Sought out feedback and opportunities to grow and develop teaching practice, collaborated with other teachers, and learned new ways to engage students in technology and education through conferences and professional development.
- Marketing and building interest in the IT/Cybersecurity Pathways to increase student enrollment, including underrepresented populations in technology.
- Provided opportunities for students to gain up to 26 college credits and CompTIA Industry Certifications while still in high school.
positions.insights: Skills: Kali Linux · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Linux · Security · Presentations · Programming · Cybersecurity Tools · Computer Networking · Course Creation · Communication · Cybersecurity · IT Service Management · Communication Protocols · Networking · Course Material · Cybersecurity Incident Response · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: CIS, CSC, & CNG Instructor
positions.description:
- My first experiences teaching were at Front Range Community College, where I learned the value of collaboration, building relationships, and creativity in building and designing lessons.
- Curriculum development for Software applications programs and certifications residing under the Computer Information Systems and Computer Science department.
- Taught and evaluated students in Introduction to PC Applications, Introduction to Computer Information Systems, and Social Media Applications courses. 
- Managed students' grades and performance in the classroom. 
- Developed engaging lesson plans for each class meeting including using various teaching methods. 
- Participated in department activities including professional development, book reviews, and pre-semester conferences. 
- Differentiated instruction based on students' needs.
positions.insights: Skills: Kali Linux · Linux · Presentations · Programming · Network Security · Cybersecurity Tools · Computer Networking · Course Creation · Communication · Cybersecurity · Communication Protocols · Networking · Course Material · Cybersecurity Incident Response · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Volunteer Committee Member
positions.description: - Collaborated with community, education, and industry to develop standards for Computer Science education in Colorado public schools grades 9-12, which are currently in place.

positions.title: Computer Science Teacher
positions.locationName: Fort Collins, Colorado, United States · On-site
positions.description:
With a diverse background in software development, website design, graphic design, and social media marketing, I have a unique opportunity to teach many different classes. My classes focus on real world applications and projects so that the students can be prepared for their next step in their education or into the workforce.

I have also worked with Poudre School District leadership to begin implementation of Colorado Department of Education Computer Science standards for high school as well as advocating for K-12 standards for Computer Science at all PSD schools.

Collaborating with elementary schools and teachers for "Family Code Night" to introduce computer science to elementary schools in the Poudre School District.

Two years teaching computer science to middle school for STEM Institutes in Poudre School District during the summer.

At Rocky Mountain High School, I taught the following classes:
   AP Computer Science Principles
   AP Computer Science A
   Game Design and Development I & II
   Introduction to Computer Science
   Mobile Applications
   Computer Applications (for FRCC Credit)
   Web Design and Development I &  II (Web Design II for FRCC Credit)

I was involved in the following clubs:
   DECA (School Sponsored)
   FBLA (School Sponsored)
   Computer & Technology Student Association (CTSA) (School Sponsored)

I have taught these classes in the past:
   Career & Financial Planning
   Business Economics
   Accounting I
positions.insights: Skills: Presentations · Course Creation · Communication · Course Material

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
- Internet marketing and website administration for client companies including: Bayou City Outdoors, Houston Single Source, Eight Friends Out, The Houston Social Source, Rose Matchmaking, Rocky mountain Home Builders, Sublime Catering, Bill Ferguson, Bonnie Savoy, DDS, Robin Chocolates, and Northern Colorado Outdoors. 
- Tracked SEO data and optimized websites and Internet marketing strategies based on goals of clients. 
- Graphics design as part of updates to all websites and e-mail marketing campaigns keeping the mission and vision of each client in mind. 
- Designed and Created e-mail marketing campaigns & e-Newsletters regularly to ensure close contact with client customers. 
- Led social media campaign effort including initial set up and ongoing management providing metrics to clients for monitoring.

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
- Integrated risk assessment metrics in Space Shuttle return-to-flight activities following Columbia disaster.
- Created processes for software Quality Assurance team.
- Witnessed testing activities for International Space Station (ISS) flight software.
- Reviewed software code in support of quality assurance activities on government equipment.
- Presented and Reported software safety information to division management weekly.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led a team responsible for creating a Graphical User Interface, using C and C++ on a UNIX platform, to integrate the Portable Computer System (PCS) with the International Space Station (ISS). During my tenure, the team received recognition for both the quality of completed work as well as process improvements.
- Generated and presented information for software quality reviews of the Portable Computer System (PCS) to be used on the International Space Station (ISS).
- Presented PCS software demonstrations for the Japanese organization, NASDA.
- Coordinated schedules and software deliveries with other ISS software subsystems in support of ISS assembly.
- Designed a website to be available for customers to access data for certification reviews and audits.
- Created processes for exporting software development tools to the International Partners.
- Led a team in creating improved processes according to documented Lessons Learned.
- Coordinated the development and maintenance of software for ISS subsystems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked as part of a team tasked to create a system for training astronauts and flight control personnel based on requirements from the International Space Station.
- Performed programming functions using a vendor-supplied software package to create a Graphical User Interface for training purposes.
- Developed software, utilizing the C language in a UNIX environment, to create the Application Program Interface, which communicates with the Graphical User Interface.

- Led a team responsible for creating a Graphical User Interface, using C and C++ on a UNIX platform, to integrate the Portable Computer System (PCS) with the International Space Station (ISS). During my tenure, the team received recognition for both the quality of completed work as well as process improvements.
- Generated and presented information for software quality reviews of the Portable Computer System (PCS) to be used on the International Space Station (ISS).
- Presented PCS software demonstrations for the Japanese organization, NASDA.
- Coordinated schedules and software deliveries with other ISS software subsystems in support of ISS assembly.
- Designed a website to be available for customers to access data for certification reviews and audits.
- Created processes for exporting software development tools to the International Partners.
- Led a team in creating improved processes according to documented Lessons Learned.
- Coordinated the development and maintenance of software for ISS subsystems.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description:
- Worked as part of a team tasked to create a system for training astronauts and flight control personnel based on requirements from the International Space Station.
- Performed programming functions using a vendor-supplied software package to create a Graphical User Interface for training purposes.
- Developed software, utilizing the C language in a UNIX environment, to create the Application Program Interface, which communicates with the Graphical User Interface.

honorsAndAwards.title: Educator of the Year Nomination
honorsAndAwards.description: Thompson Education Foundation provides opportunities for teachers to be recognized for their work each year. I am honored to be nominated for this prestigious award for the 2022-23 school year for the work that I do at Thompson Career Campus.
honorsAndAwards.issuer: Issued by Thompson Education Foundation · Mar 2023
